title: HB2636 (2019-2020 Regular): Prohibiting the possession of large capacity ammunition magazines and the carrying of handguns with large capacity ammunition magazines.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Kansas) (gun-policy Stage 5, Kansas); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kansas text (Introduced; official copy, https://www.kslegislature.gov/li_2020/b2019_20/measures/documents/hb2636_00_0000.pdf)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed); no votes recorded, no date in text. Penalty quote in Section 1 is subsection (b)(2) as it reads after the bill, printed with a missing comma after (a)(5) because of a struck 'or'; it makes (a)(19) a level 9 felony. Quotes (19) and 2(a)(6) end with a stray space before the period in the source. Lab-employee exemption also extended to (a)(19).

operative_text:
Section 1 (K.S.A. 21-6301): (19) possessing, manufacturing, causing to be manufactured, selling, offering for sale, lending, purchasing or giving away any large capacity ammunition magazine designed for use with a handgun whether the person knows or has reason to know the size of the magazine.
Section 1 (K.S.A. 21-6301): (5) "Large capacity ammunition magazine" means an ammunition feeding device that physically extends below the bottom of the grip of a handgun when fully seated into such handgun.
Section 1 (K.S.A. 21-6301): (3) "Handgun" means a firearm that is designed to be fired by the use of a single hand.
Section 1 (K.S.A. 21-6301): (2) subsection (a)(4), (a)(5) (a)(6) or (a)(19) is a severity level 9, nonperson felony;
Section 2 (K.S.A. 21-6302): (6) a handgun with a large capacity ammunition magazine whether the person knows or has reason to know the size of the magazine.
Section 2 (K.S.A. 21-6302): (2) subsection (a)(5) or (a)(6) is a severity level 9, nonperson felony.
